summary: Tessa delivery evidence (Nicole Hill): creates ea_email_events (append-only bounce / inbound / supersede / restore evidence per address), ea_contact_email_history (every address-book email change with the old address and evidence), ea_contacts.superseded_by_contact_id, and ea_supersede_email() which atomically moves a contact off a hard-bounced address onto the verified address that replaced it. Workpaper only; no existing row changes.

preflight.name: ea_contacts exists (344)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_contacts'

preflight.name: ea_email_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_email_events'

preflight.name: ea_contacts.superseded_by_contact_id does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_contacts' AND column_name = 'superseded_by_contact_id'

expected_changes: Creates table ea_email_events (email lowercased CHECK, kind IN bounce/inbound/supersede/restore, UNIQUE (email, kind, message_ref), restore must name a human, supersede must name a different lowercased address) with an append-only trigger (no UPDATE or DELETE).
Creates table ea_contact_email_history (contact + merged-into FKs ON DELETE SET NULL, reason IN bounced_superseded).
Adds nullable ea_contacts.superseded_by_contact_id (self FK ON DELETE SET NULL, never itself). Every existing contact keeps NULL.

Creates ea_supersede_email(text, text, text, timestamptz, jsonb, text): refuses unless the old address has an unrestored bounce and the new one does not; records the supersede event; moves the contact row onto the new address, or points it at the row that already holds it; writes history.
Grants SELECT, INSERT on both new tables and EXECUTE on the function to service_role only.
No existing row in any table is changed.

verify.name: both tables exist and are empty
verify.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM ea_email_events) + (SELECT count(*) FROM ea_contact_email_history))::int

verify.name: no contact points anywhere yet
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM ea_contacts WHERE superseded_by_contact_id IS NOT NULL

verify.name: one event per address + kind + message (unique constraint present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_ea_email_events' AND contype = 'u'

verify.name: evidence is append-only (trigger present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_ea_email_events_immutable'

verify.name: service_role can read and insert evidence and history, and run the supersede; anon cannot run it
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'ea_email_events', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'ea_email_events', 'INSERT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'ea_contact_email_history', 'INSERT') AND has_function_privilege('service_role', 'ea_supersede_email(text,text,text,timestamptz,jsonb,text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'ea_supersede_email(text,text,text,timestamptz,jsonb,text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
